title: cyperus iria f. diaphaniria
intro: Cyperus iria f. diaphaniria, commonly known as Cyperus rotundus f. diaphaniria, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae) and is native to tropical regions. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus iria f. diaphaniria include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that are responsible for its medicinal properties.
